page.overview:
What is The Dance of the Hawk and the Hummingbird?

The Dance of the Hawk and the Hummingbird, by Teven Aerwin, is a book "which purported to set forth the proper conduct of men toward women and women toward men." Lady Amalisa Jagad's copy was burnt by Liandrin.
